title: First box was not good.
text:
Well, this is 40dollars box. So you expect something quality, with good value like all subscriptions do.
First box was Jungle Jack. You can build a structure with cardboard material, but it only lasted one day. Injection tube couldn't hold anymore, so it stopped working after couple of uses.. well, if it was 25dollars, I would say you get what you paid for. And it is all about experiment itself, so cheap material is all ok.
But with 40dollars? Well... This is highly not valuable for your money. I also subscribe different brands, this is at the bottom pile. I would go for one more month, but if it repeats, we are done.
label: neutral
